Every public service method must be declared by its local interface.

Back to STX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Every public service method must be declared by its local interface. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the The Standard family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0015: Every public service method must be declared by its local interface.
interface IStudentService { ValueTask<Student> GetStudent(Guid studentId); }
class StudentService : IStudentService
{
    public ValueTask DeleteStudent(Guid studentId) => default;
}

Good code example

// Follows STX0015
interface IStudentService
{
    ValueTask<Student> GetStudent(Guid studentId);
    ValueTask DeleteStudent(Guid studentId);
}
